versions.changelog:
lovart-skill 1.1.0

- Project link now always appended after every generation.
- Results with failures: user is informed when a model or reference was refused and why.
- Removed deprecated skill-card.md file.
- Version bump and documentation updates for improved result handling and reporting.

lovart-skill v1.0.12

- Updated version to 1.0.12 in SKILL.md and metadata
- Minor documentation/tweaks in SKILL.md; no new commands or user-facing behavior changes
- Removed legacy skill-card.md file

lovart-skill 1.0.11

- Added main agent logic to scripts/agent_skill.py, relocating from root to improve organization.
- Enhanced SKILL.md: now includes metadata fields such as version, author, license, homepage, platforms, and detailed tags for discoverability.
- Standardized prerequisites and clarified command/environment requirements.
- Removed obsolete agent_skill.py (root) and skill-card.md files.

lovart-skill 1.0.10

- Updated SKILL.md for improved clarity and detailed usage rules; mostly editorial/formatting changes.
- No functional code changes to command sets or logic; documentation aligned tightly with operational guidance.
- Maintains strict command usage, error handling, and user interaction as before.

Version 1.0.9

- Updated SKILL.md documentation (no changes to code).
- Clarified and expanded usage instructions, error handling, and step-by-step operation requirements.
- Improved rule definitions for project selection, thread management, and artifact delivery.
- No functional or API changes; this is a documentation-only update.

- Improved error handling: now uses the server's user-facing error messages directly for quota, billing, risk control, and other 402 errors, instead of parsing internal error codes.
- Minor clarifications to confirmation flow: highlights that some premium image variants also require explicit user approval before consuming credits.
- Slightly expanded instructions in error handling and confirmation to reduce ambiguity and ensure consistent user communication.
- No command/API/behavior changes—documentation and guidance were updated for clarity and accuracy.

lovart-skill 1.0.7

- Added strict detection and handling for silent generation failures (when status is "done" but no artifacts are produced).
- Clarified post-generation checking: now agents must verify result["generation_succeeded"], show user warnings, and surface agent_message when a request can't be completed.
- Updated documentation (SKILL.md) to reflect required user messaging, troubleshooting, and workflow for these silent failures.
- No code changes outside of doc/procedure updates.

No changes detected in version 1.0.6.

- No file changes were made in this release.

lovart-skill 1.0.5

- Error handling logic for the `chat` command has been improved: now matches HTTP status codes and structured error codes for clearer, more accurate user messages.
- New error handling table with HTTP status, internal code, and interpretation.
- Original error handling by message fragment matching is now a fallback, not primary.
- No code or logic changes beyond updated documentation; no file changes detected.

Version 1.0.3 of lovart-skill

- No file changes detected.
- Behavior and features remain unchanged from the previous release.

Version 1.0.2 of lovart-skill

- Added the watch command to the list of allowed Lovart operations.
- Clarified that all Lovart operations should use one of: chat, send, watch, confirm, result, status, config, projects, project-add, project-switch, project-rename, project-remove, threads, thread-remove, upload, upload-artifact, download, set-mode, query-mode, create-project.
- No functional logic changes beyond documentation update.

lovart-skill v1.0.1 changelog:

- Minor clarification: Rule #0 now allows users to freely read the source code to verify it, but prohibits modifying skill source code during execution to "debug" issues.
- No changes to commands, features, or behavior.

lovart-skill v1.0.0

- Initial release of the Lovart skill for generating images, videos, and audio/music via Lovart AI.
- Supports creation and management of Lovart projects, threads (conversation history), and user settings.
- Fully command-driven: all Lovart operations must use provided skill commands; direct API calls are not allowed.
- Enforces explicit project and region setup before first use; supports both global and mainland China users.
- Handles generation flow, cost confirmations, project/thread switching, error management, and delivery of generated files with project links.
- Designed to be directly invoked by users for both creative and project-management requests.
